text: Full-screen TUI agent reads codebase, edits files, compiles, tests, and shows a diff for review before committing changes
quote: ByteAsk opens a full-screen TUI, reads your codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests, and presents a diff for your review before making permanent changes

text: Connects to a running gdb session via a bridge, reads live debugger state, and asks permission before changing anything
quote: ByteAsk joins through a bridge you start in your gdb, reads the live state, and asks before it changes anything.

text: Returns raw debugging reports with intact frames, files, and line numbers so users can verify the agent's reasoning
quote: It hands back the raw report with the frames, files and line numbers intact, so you can check the agent's reasoning against the same evidence.

text: Provides an `exec` subcommand that runs a task to completion and exits, suited for scripting and CI pipelines
quote: `byteask exec` - it runs one task to completion and exits.

text: Can stream the session as JSON Lines on stdout, one event per line, for pipelines to consume programmatically
quote: Streams the session as JSON Lines on stdout - one event per line. Use it when a pipeline needs to consume the run rather than a human reading it.

text: Can constrain final model output to conform to a supplied JSON Schema file for reliable parsing
quote: Point at a JSON Schema file and the model's final response conforms to it, so you can parse the resu

text: Requires approval before taking actions, with an approval policy configurable via --ask-for-approval
quote: ByteAsk asks for your approval before taking actions. The policy is set via `--ask-for-approval`

text: Lets users bring any OpenAI-compatible model into the TUI and use it like a built-in model
quote: Bring **any OpenAI-compatible model** into the ByteAsk TUI and drive it exactly like a built-in cloud model.

text: Connects third-party model providers (OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Cerebras, Fireworks) using just an API key
quote: byteask models add <alias> --provider openrouter --key sk-...` connects OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Cerebras, or Fireworks with just your own key

text: Supports magic-link email sign-in so users can start without configuring an API key
quote: ByteAsk uses **magic-link email sign-in** - no API key required by default.

text: Provides page-cited answers sourced from embedded and firmware reference docs for coding agents needing precise register values
quote: Page-cited answers from embedded & firmware reference docs — for coding agents that can't afford to guess a register value.

text: Shows current plan and how much of each usage window has been consumed
quote: Shows your current plan and how much of each usage window you've spent.

text: A read-only run can still build the program under AddressSanitizer and execute it
quote: A read-only run can still build your program under AddressSanitizer and run it.

text: Edits the repository, then drives real toolchain steps (sanitizers, test suite, an open gdb session) and produces a diff that survived debugging
quote: It edits your repository from the terminal, then drives the real toolchain - sanitizers, your test suite, and any gdb session you already have open - and hands you a diff that survived the debugger.

text: Passing --sandbox workspace-write allows the agent to build, test, and write files
quote: If you want the agent to build, test, or write files, pass `--sandbox workspace-write`.

text: `byteask queue` lets a user send a message into an already-running session from another terminal
quote: `byteask queue` sends a message into a running session from another terminal

text: `/recap` command summarizes the current session on demand
quote: `/recap` summarizes on demand

text: `/cd` and `/pwd` let users change and view the working directory mid-conversation
quote: `/cd` and `/pwd` change and show the working directory mid-conversation

text: `/agents` opens a session command center for managing agent sessions
quote: `/agents` opens a session command center

text: Provides live editor connectors for VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains IDEs (CLion, IDEA, PyCharm)
quote: VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains (CLion, IDEA, PyCharm) connectors are live.

text: `auto` mode automatically chains across three models and two providers, falling back if one is unavailable
quote: `auto` is a chain across three models and two providers rather than one fixed choice, so if one is having a bad day your turn quietly lands on the next
